## Intent and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, what changes for the user/research workflow,
and the related issue.

## Acceptance evidence

List completed deliverables and evidence for the issue's acceptance criteria.
Distinguish synthetic tests from real-data or experiment validation.

## Validation

Include exact commands and results, plus the CI run for the current PR head.

## Limits

Record material remaining constraints or deviations; use “None” when applicable.
Add `Closes #N` only when the issue is fully implemented and verified.
